name: balseraphs_worker
description: a Balseraphs Worker, a slim young labourer dressed like a jester: a wide floppy purple hat with a gold band and a gold bell on its drooping tip, ginger hair, a green-purple-and-gold harlequin vest over a white shirt with puffed short sleeves, bare forearms, a small white jester-mask charm hanging at the hip, baggy purple trousers with gold bells, tall brown leather boots, and a long wooden hoe with a grey steel blade gripped by the end of its shaft in his RIGHT hand
hands: the hoe's shaft end stays in his right hand on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the shaft lower down toward the blade, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the shaft, the hoe is lifted high above the head with its shaft slanting down to the right behind the head and its steel blade out at the right
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the hoe hand behind the head and the hoe's steel blade hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the left hand an empty fist tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the hoe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the hoe is level, its steel blade pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: hoe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the hoe's steel blade chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the hoe carries on down until its steel blade nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, ginger hair and the hat's belled tip trailing back, the empty left fist trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the hoe comes back toward its resting angle with the steel blade low at the lower-right, the left hand reaching for the shaft

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (hoe arm thrown out to the left with the hoe swung level across in front of the face, its steel blade out to the right; the empty left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the hoe held level across the belly, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, hoe arm flung up, the hoe hanging down across the body, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the hoe lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the hoe's steel blade resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the hoe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the purple hat stays on his head
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the purple hat still on his head; the hoe lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the hat's belled tip flops
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the purple hat on his head, the hoe on the ground beside him
